title: Ratios and Rates
preview: Understand ratios, build equivalent-ratio tables and graphs, convert measurement units, and reason about rates and unit rates in context.
description: Indiana standards 6.RP.2–4 and 6.GM.1. Students reason about ratios across tables, graphs, and equations, and apply unit-rate thinking to real-world problems including measurement conversions.

sections.label: 1-1 Understand Ratios
sections.description: Use ratio language to describe relationships between two quantities; write ratios in three equivalent forms.

sections.label: 1-2 Tables of Equivalent Ratios
sections.description: Build ratio tables; find missing values; identify equivalent ratios.

sections.label: 1-3 Graphs of Equivalent Ratios
sections.description: Plot pairs of equivalent ratios on the coordinate plane and interpret the resulting line.

sections.label: 1-4 Compare Ratio Relationships
sections.description: Compare two ratio relationships using tables, graphs, or unit rates.

sections.label: 1-5 Solve Ratio Problems
sections.description: Use tape diagrams, double number lines, tables, or equations to solve real-world ratio problems.

sections.label: 1-6 Convert Customary Measurement Units
sections.description: Convert between US customary and metric units; apply conversions to solve problems.

sections.label: 1-7 Understand Rates and Unit Rates
sections.description: Define unit rate; use unit-rate language in context.

sections.label: 1-8 Solve Rate Problems
sections.description: Apply unit rates to solve multi-step real-world problems.
